verdict.rationale: Twenty documents CSV/XLSX/API import with field mapping, duplicate detection, error handling, and reference-by-unique-field for relations (owners via Workspace Member email), which covers records and ownership mapping. However there is no evidence of dedicated CRM-to-CRM migration tooling, preservation of full activity/history logs, or connector-based migration from specific competitor CRMs, and community feedback flags an 'alpha-version' feel with rough edges.
